comprehensive_ml_oxide_dataset.name: Train XGBoost model
comprehensive_ml_oxide_dataset.description: Generate a comprehensive dataset of oxide polymorphs from Materials Project and train an XGBoost model to predict formation energies. This task includes: (1) retrieving a diverse set of polymorphs with oxide composition, (2) consolidating data into ML-ready format, (3) training XGBoost model, and (4) evaluating model performance with cross-validation. The goal is to create a robust ML model that can predict formation energies across diverse oxide materials.
